title: Friday Night Happy Hour Cruise on Lake Minnetonka
blurb:
Enjoy a laid-back evening on Lake Minnetonka with the Friday Night Happy Hour Cruise. This 2-hour voyage features a soundtrack of classics from the 70s, 80s, and today while you take in the beautiful scenery. Each guest receives a complimentary drink—choose from a soft drink, beer, or wine—and savor packaged snacks as you relax and unwind on the water. Perfect for ages 18 and up, this cruise promises a perfect blend of music, views, and good vibes.

- 2-hour cruise on scenic Lake Minnetonka
- 1 Complimentary drink and snacks included (could be soft drink, beer or wine)
- Music from the 70s, 80s, and contemporary hits
- Great for ages 18 and up, ideal for a fun night out
